contract.prepare: No model requests; fetches current pinned MCP metadata; freezes tasks, catalogs, config, source code and relevant locks. Save plan.json + plan.sha256.
contract.run: Sequential seeded schedule; adapt then shared runner then exactly five official-rubric judge attempts. Explicit run is API execution. Single writer; no score-driven retries.
contract.resume: Reuse completed/failed records and verify hashes; retain interrupted directories without silently rerunning; regenerate new experiment after code/config/input changes.
contract.report: Development diagnostic tables; reviewed suites additionally export evaluation manifests/ledgers and matched TF/PE/ECS/recovery/retention/cost CSVs through existing evaluation.py. Truncation and provider filtering are execution failures, not completion.
contract.request_retry: Agent/judge/updater: one identical-request retry for connection failure/429/5xx, backoff 2s and Retry-After up to 60s. Record each retry with unknown usage. No trajectory/tool/semantic retries.
contract.papers: Interactive install/login/link/source/prepare/run flow. Browser login and site selection belong to user; valid state reused. User can --prepare-only.
contract.preflight: Real low-token endpoint requests before new cells, separate costs in preflight/*.json; same plan controls across strategies. Stop after two consecutive model transport failures; untouched cells remain pending.
contract.judge: Pinned original rubric; five attempts; JSON object output mode, reasoning disabled. Unscored v1 measurement trial and failed v1.1 connection trial retained; course-v1.2 is fresh complete rerun.
